question: Should OpenClaw core add first-class per-agent backup/restore/clone commands, and if so how should they handle credentials, transcripts, path rewrites, and overlap with broader backup/snapshot work?
rationale: The request is feasible but chooses a sensitive persisted-state and recovery contract; automated review cannot safely decide whether the permanent product surface is per-agent flags, a broader restore/import command, or a plugin-oriented workflow.

options.title: Approve Scoped Core Flow
options.body: Design a core per-agent export/import or restore/clone flow with security review, dry-run validation, rollback handling, and focused tests.

options.title: Fold Into Backup Umbrella
options.body: Track this as a requirement under the broader native backup/restore work and avoid a separate command path until archive semantics are settled.

options.title: Document Manual Recovery Only
options.body: Keep first-class clone out of core for now and document a supported manual or plugin-assisted recovery path.

recommendation.title: Approve Scoped Core Flow
recommendation.body: Design a core per-agent export/import or restore/clone flow with security review, dry-run validation, rollback handling, and focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the likely routing owner from recent backup-area history and maintainer-side review context, while the final decision still needs product/security approval.
